title: The Lady, or the Tiger?
author: Frank R. Stockton
description: "The Lady, or the Tiger?" by Frank R.
longDescription: Stockton is a short story published in 1882. In a semi-barbaric kingdom, accused criminals face trial by choosing between two doors—one concealing a lady they must marry, the other a deadly tiger.

authorInfo.bio: Frank Richard Stockton was an American writer and humorist, best known today for a series of innovative children's fairy tales that were widely popular during the last decades of the 19th century.
